name: KTM 390 Adventure
engine: 373 or 399 cc liquid-cooled single, fuel injected
intro: KTM's small adventure bike. Several recalls on 2022-on bikes, including an e-throttle recall.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls first
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 2022-2024 bikes are in recall 25V598 (water in the e-throttle can cause loss of drive). 2025 Adventure R and X bikes are in recalls 25V825 (ECU software) and 25V907 (side stand spring can break).
A-002.reason: Losing drive power in traffic is dangerous. Every fix is free.

recalls.what: Water can get into the e-throttle unit and cause loss of drive power.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the throttle assembly free.

recalls.what: Side stand spring may break from vibration and let the stand drop.
